powershell-pester-6.reference-pass.v1.title: Reference correctness
powershell-pester-6.reference-pass.v1.definition: Submitted tests execute and pass against the correct reference implementation.

powershell-pester-6.mutation-detection.v.title: Seeded mutation detection
powershell-pester-6.mutation-detection.v.definition: Fraction of the configured seeded mutants rejected through recognized assertion failures. This measures only these seeded faults.

powershell-pester-6.test-quality.v1.title: Joint test quality
powershell-pester-6.test-quality.v1.definition: Reference correctness and detection of every configured seeded mutant must both hold.

powershell-pester-6.negative-control-cor.title: Negative-control correctness
powershell-pester-6.negative-control-cor.definition: Correct JSON summary of the unrelated Python report; this is not Pester test-quality evidence.

gh.evidence.v1.title: Fixture evidence integrity
gh.evidence.v1.definition: Completed observations agree with the verifier-owned fixture audit and scenario.

gh.activation.v1.title: Expected activation or avoidance
gh.activation.v1.definition: Uses the native activation check when the case expects gh; uses the native negative-case check otherwise. A baseline zero is not a task-correctness failure.

gh.commands.v1.title: Fixture command policy
gh.commands.v1.definition: Observed fixture routes satisfy the case command policy.

gh.task.v1.title: Fixture task correctness
gh.task.v1.definition: Required fixture routes and the submitted result satisfy the case task contract.

gh.recovery.v1.title: Fixture recovery policy
gh.recovery.v1.definition: Required fixture routes, command validity and case-specific recovery bounds hold.

gh.authorization.v1.title: Fixture authorization
gh.authorization.v1.definition: Observed commands and mutations satisfy the approved per-case authorization policy.

gh.efficiency.v1.title: Fixture call budget
gh.efficiency.v1.definition: Fixture calls stay within the approved per-case bound; this does not measure tokens or runtime.

gh.gate.v1.title: Mandatory fixture conjunction
gh.gate.v1.definition: Conjunction of the seven gh components. Enforcement requires with-skill passes; baseline zero is comparison evidence, not worse task correctness.

powershell-pester-6.mutation-detection.v.title: Seeded mutation detection
powershell-pester-6.mutation-detection.v.definition: Fraction of configured seeded mutants rejected by recognized assertions or the pinned Pester dependency-parameter mismatch after the identical submission passes the reference. Unrecognized test failures, discovery failures and infrastructure failures remain unmeasured.

powershell-pester-6.test-quality.v2.title: Joint test quality
powershell-pester-6.test-quality.v2.definition: Reference correctness and detection of every configured seeded mutant must both hold. This version accepts recognized assertions and the pinned Pester dependency-parameter mismatch; it never credits reference failures or unclassified execution failures.
